apps.localizedDescription:
Erosion-CN 是面向 iOS / iPadOS 27.0–27.2.1 & 27.3 beta 1（及 26.x 部分功能）的中英双语系统配置与 MobileGestalt 研究工具箱（防白苹果安全加固版）。

• 原位覆盖写入（pwrite + F_FULLFSYNC）与写后全量读回校验，杜绝重启反弹与 0 字节白苹果
• 无损 CoreFoundation 类型直通，根治相机取景黑屏
• 运行时动态解析 libMobileGestalt.dylib 槽位 + 双金库 SHA-256 备份一键恢复原厂
• 支持国行 Apple 智能解锁、海外 eSIM 与 FaceTime 音频开启、应用存档备份、缓存清理与电池/崩溃诊断

⚠️ 签名要求：安装时请务必保留 App Group 权限（SideStore / AltStore / Feather 默认支持）。

Bilingual (English + Simplified Chinese) bootloop-hardened MobileGestalt & cross-container research toolkit for iOS/iPadOS 27.x. Requires at least one App Group entitlement when signing.

## Erosion-CN v1.0.8 (Build 33)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **System Compatibility / 系统兼容性提示**  
> - **Supported / 完整支持**：`iOS / iPadOS 27.0 – 27.2.1` and `27.3 beta 1` (`24C503*`).  
> - **Patched / 已封堵**：Apple patched `worse_query` starting in **`iOS 27.3 beta 2` (`24C5049d+`)**. Do **NOT** update past `27.3 beta 1` if you rely on Erosion-CN.

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **Dedicated "Import Files" (Multi-Select) & "Import Folder" (Recursive Copy) / 拆分「导入文件（多选）」与「导入文件夹（递归复制）」** *(Thanks to [@leopoldchou](https://github.com/leopoldchou) in [#75](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/75) / 感谢 [@leopoldchou](https://github.com/leopoldchou) 在 [#75](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/75) 提出)*
   - Split file and folder picking into two dedicated menu entries in `FileBrowserView` with automatic container write-access grants and streaming copies without memory spikes.
   - Added a collision prompt when destination names already exist: **Keep Both** (auto-numbered renaming with paired SQLite companion sync) or **Replace** (atomic safe swap).

2. **Multi-Select Mode & Batch Action Bar / 多选模式与底部批量操作栏**
   - Added **Select Items… / 选择文件…** in the top-right action menu with **Select All / Deselect All** controls and a bottom action bar supporting **Batch Share / 批量分享**, **Batch Zip / 批量打包**, and **Batch Delete / 批量删除** (with destructive confirmation and per-item failure reporting).

3. **Destructive Delete Confirmations & Actionable Error Alerts / 删除二次确认弹窗与真实错误提示**
   - Added red destructive confirmation dialogs showing exact target names/counts before deleting any single file, folder, or multi-selected batch.
   - Surfaced exact localized failure reasons across Delete, Unzip, Zip, Rename (now pre-filled with the current filename), Duplicate, and New File/Folder/Plist actions.

4. **ZIP Extraction Confirmation & Dual Mode / ZIP 解压缩确认与双模式解压**
   - Tapping or long-pressing a `.zip` file now asks for confirmation with two choices: **Extract to Current Folder / 解压到当前目录** or **Extract to Subfolder / 解压到同名文件夹** (avoiding name collisions).
   - Runs off the main thread with a live status indicator, pre-validates path traversal and archive symlink escapes, and displays the exact failure reason in an alert when extraction fails.

5. **File Manager Safety & UX Hardening / 文件管理器底层安全护栏与交互增强**
   - **Container Root & Protected Path Guard / 容器根目录与高危文件保护**：Blocks deleting, renaming, or overwriting app/system container roots, container metadata plists, factory backup vault files, `.erosion_adlock` sentinels, and `com.apple.MobileGestalt.plist`.
   - **SQLite Companion Set (`-wal` / `-shm` / `-journal`) Protection / SQLite 伴随文件联动保护**：Uses non-invasive `fcntl(F_GETLK)` and active 10-second WAL write checks to block modifying in-use databases, syncs companions on delete/rename/Keep-Both import, and translates `EAGAIN (35)` / `EBUSY` / `EACCES` / `ENOSPC` into clear bilingual guidance.
   - **Folder Rename, Empty/No-Results States & Optional Async Folder Sizes / 文件夹重命名、空目录占位与可选文件夹体积**：Added guarded folder rename, `ContentUnavailableView` empty/search states, stable path-based item IDs, and an optional **Show Folder Sizes / 显示文件夹大小** toggle in Browser Settings (asynchronous POSIX sizing integrated with Size sorting).

> 📜 Full changelog / 完整更新日志：**[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)** · User Guide / 使用指南：**[USAGE_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/USAGE_GUIDE.md)**

---

### Install & Checksum / 下载安装与校验

- **SideStore / AltStore / Feather Official Source / 官方更新源**：`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/main/apps.json` *(auto-synced by CI after release / 发版后由 GitHub Actions 自动同步)*
- **IPA Asset / 安装包文件**：`Erosion_v1.0.8_Bilingual.ipa` (`7,081,576` bytes; preserve `App Group` entitlements when signing)
- **SHA-256**：`44186817c66b8d6be18530ca47107408337f0c3c60ffa6d6e7d7c435272ac3c6`

### What's New / 更新内容

Includes a removable default crash-guard entry for **SMZDM (`什么值得买` · `com.smzdm.client.ios`)**.

2. **Built-In Taobao Splash Boot Paths / 内置手机淘宝开屏启动图与配置路径识别** *(Thanks to [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) for sharing in [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) / 感谢 [@guestwrt](https://github.com/guestwrt) 在 [#56](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/56) 实测反馈)*

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **Fixed Unresponsive "Clean Selected" in Container Cache Cleaner (`CacheCleanerView`) / 修复容器缓存「一键清理已选」不生效** *(Thanks to [@KindLin99](https://github.com/KindLin99) for reporting [#53](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/53) / 感谢 [@KindLin99](https://github.com/KindLin99) 反馈 [#53](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/53))*
   - **Separated Button Styles in Overview Card**：Assigned `.borderless` to **Rescan** (`重新扫描`) and promoted **Clean Selected** (`一键清理已选`) to a full-width `.borderedProminent` button snapshotting targets prior to confirmation, eliminating SwiftUI `List` multi-button tap hijacking.
   - **Prevented Row Hit-Box Hijacking**：Replaced inline `NavigationLink` on **Inspect** (`查看`) with a `.borderless` button + `.navigationDestination(item:)` so tapping row checkboxes or **Clean** (`清理`) never triggers accidental navigation.
   - **Ad-Sentinel Protection & Re-Sized Refresh**：Unified scan/purge traversal depth (`Library/Caches` depth `7`, `tmp` depth `6`), skipped `.erosion_adlock` anti-recreate ad folders during cleanup, and updated remaining bytes / auth failure reporting accurately after purge.

2. **Explicit Read-Only & Sentinel State in `InfoViewer` / 文件详情页只读与防重建状态提示**
   - When a directory or file is already at `0555` / `0444`, the **Set Read-Only** preset button now automatically disables and displays `Already Read-Only` (`当前已是只读锁死状态`) or `Read-Only & Sentinel Active` (`当前已是只读防重建锁死状态`) alongside an `Anti-Recreate Lock` row (`Active (.erosion_adlock)`).
   - **Restore Read-Write** and **Apply** buttons disable when permissions already match, and restoring write permission on a sentinel directory from `InfoViewer` cleanly unlinks `.erosion_adlock`.

3. **Target Highlighting & Auto-Scroll on Ad Locator (`FileBrowserView` / `AdCacheBlockerView`) / 去广告「定位」自动高亮与居中定位**
   - Tapping **Locate** (`定位`) in Splash Ad Blocker now highlights the target ad folder/config inside its parent directory and scrolls smoothly to center it, with read-only sandbox grants for locator browsing and container grants ordered prior to `lstat` attribute checks.

> 📜 Full changelog / 完整更新日志：**[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)** · User Guide / 使用指南：**[USAGE_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/blob/main/USAGE_GUIDE.md)**

> [!IMPORTANT]

---

### What's New / 更新内容

1. **Non-Blocking Cold Start in Custom Lock Screen Wallpapers + `Camlo · 开幕` Guide (`PosterBoardView`) / 「自定义锁屏壁纸」零阻塞秒开与 Camlo 动态壁纸引导** *(Special thanks to [@iiichika](https://github.com/iiichika) for the thorough root-cause report in [#51](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/51) / 特别感谢 [@iiichika](https://github.com/iiichika) 在 [#51](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/51) 的详细根因排查)*
   - **Instant UI & Import Ready**：Removed the full-screen `isReady` gate so the `.tendies` list, bottom import button, and top-right menu load immediately without blocking on cold `PosterBoard` container discovery (fixing the ~39s+ blank screen on iPad / fresh installs).
   - **Background Lookup & Actionable Retry**：`com.apple.PosterBoard` container resolution now runs asynchronously in the background with an inline status/retry banner, and tapping **Apply** (`应用`) when unready shows an actionable **Retry Lookup** (`重新定位`) alert instead of silently staying disabled.
   - **Built-In `Camlo · 开幕` Companion Card**：Added a bilingual card at the top of `Custom Lock Screen Wallpapers` introducing our companion on-device dynamic wallpaper studio **[Camlo](https://github.com/Kianuni/Camlo)** (~9 MB, swipe-reveal transitions, Live Photo/video & 3D depth lock screens, 385+ free cloud & museum wallpapers, `.tendies` export) with direct GitHub access and a one-tap **Add Repo Source** menu for SideStore / AltStore / Feather.

2. **Fixed Horizontal Card Clipping in Splash Ad Blocker (`AdCacheBlockerView`) / 修复「开屏广告缓存精准锁死」概览卡片排版溢出** *(Thanks to [@wvcq6xxvkj-star](https://github.com/wvcq6xxvkj-star) for reporting [#52](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/52) / 感谢 [@wvcq6xxvkj-star](https://github.com/Kianuni/Erosion-CN/issues/52) 反馈)*

1. **Anti-Recreate Sentinel Lock (`0555` + `0444` `.erosion_adlock`) / 防重建占位锁加固**
   - Locking an ad directory now wipes existing ad files, places a 0-byte `0444` read-only sentinel file (`.erosion_adlock`) inside, and sets `0555` on the directory so ad SDKs cannot remove an empty `0555` folder and recreate a fresh `0755` folder under writable parent directories.

   - Add custom ad folders or config files via the top-right **`+`** button or by long-pressing any eligible item in File Browser → **Add to Ad Blocker** (`加入广告锁死列表`), strictly enforcing safety guards against system directories, container roots, `Downloads`, symlinks, and core app preference plists.

4. **Boundary & Network Pairing Guidance / 生效边界与搭配建议**
   - Added a dedicated notice card inside `Splash Ad Blocker` reminding users that local directory/config locking stops disk caching while live ad network requests still fire — pairing with proxy ad-blocking rules (Surge / Quantumult X / Loon / Stash / Shadowrocket, etc.) gives complete coverage.
